## Numbered rework response

1. **F1:** ADR sections 1/3 and composite F1 replace v2's second setup/spawn/Verified route with STORE-ONLY constraint reservation, then the one signed common lifecycle publisher, then receipt observation. Pass exact action/input/allowed-output digests and checked reservation receipt; common validates again in its ordered store phase. Common owns provisional effects/final sample/C/receipt/original-child release. No epic spawn/retry/recovered release. Caller/held-lock table preserves home→repo→seats→store→queues→drain→manifests→verdict→merge→Git, with READY/callback/network/waits outside seat. Forge-only optional lease never nests store/common entry. Current launch functions are not the missing consumer hook. Common isolation hook/receipt mapping and checked writer/hook-safe adapter are named unprovided prerequisites; affected positive setup/claim/queue/worktree/launch refuses before effects. No issuer or release schema is created.
2. **F2:** ADR section 4 requires checked Result receipt over exact serialized objects/membership/evidence, action/input/output digests, committed tree/commit and readback/durability. auto_commit_paths and ordinary atomic-update success are explicitly insufficient. Stage/commit/file/dir-sync/readback faults permit no effect. Required hook-safe Git adapter is dependency at existing common/TASK-1332 seam, not a new local adapter or hook bypass. Pending remains committed across partial result/status/evidence output until complete checked output receipt and later terminal constraint observation. Strict committed-snapshot reads cannot use dirty/partial Completed/Landed YAML. Committed, NoEffectFailure and UncertainEffect are distinct; recovery can finish store projection, never release vendor or replay setup.
3. **F3:** ADR sections 2/5, matrix and child amendment reserve Ordinary OR Isolated context, ancestor/reciprocal edges, declaration absence, sticky members, covered descendants and repo/default predicates. Candidate graph validation recomputes old AND candidate contexts for active reservations, including common writes, new ancestors/descendants, import/default changes. Caller affected-ID lists or old-member overlap cannot omit a phantom. Only exact action/common-owned declared outputs are exempt. Declaration and ordinary in-flight admission serialize; unfenceable running work blocks positive declaration, no peer cancellation or retroactive merge guarantee.

## Binding R1–R4 and retained profile amendments

- R1: full guard inventory/aliases and MCP peek-versus-real-claim distinction retained. Read/selection positives can ship independently of unsupported lifecycle positives; no fake launch required. Release authority alone does NOT block protective first-slice signoff. Exact corrected F1–F3 architecture still needs NEW advisor; ordinary positive controls now obey absence reservations.
- R2: original child definition/reopen evidence and immutable predecessor coverage/evidence IDs retained, cycle/missing-link refusal explicit. Narrow initial squash rule is EXACT: reviewed base ancestor of source; actual first parent/base equals reviewed base; actual result tree equals reviewed source tree; forge confirms repo/PR/source/base/result; authoritative default reachability required for Completed. No unspecified equivalent-patch/general merge-tree algorithm. Reverted/omitted/reopened/new child work/body trailers cannot expand coverage after clone/clear/remap/replay.
- R3: source pin not atomic base/default. Documented AIDA-cooperative boundary is preserved without universally demanding protection from raw forge users; a stricter mode needing unavailable atomic condition refuses. TTL/RAII/slug branch leases are not fencing. Pending/Uncertain never expires into permission.
- R4: Option<BranchRef>, None/no-sync default, actual default for off-default absent parent, same-target no-op. Generic force gives no release. Future live/unlanded release remains unselected; complete verified landing clear still requires current full coverage and quiescence. Refusing partial slice does not satisfy full old AC4/5 or whole epic.
- Profile P1–P3: unchanged V2 full profile and gap remain accurate AS AMENDED. New relay narrows matrix interpretation to proof obligations for the claimed adapter/mode, not mandatory every-vendor/OS support/general hostile-process confinement or banning ordinary source edits. Strong AC2, no-exemptions and positive edit/build requirement retained. No supported backend currently shown; functional story remains unready. No broker/narrowing/new operator question/global containment change inferred. Profile must consume common single publisher, never add its own release owner.

## Named paired verification obligations — proposed, NOT RUN

Preserve V2 actual-entrypoint/alias/coverage/reopen/revert/body/clone/clear and profile positives/negatives. Add ordinary_admission_blocks_new_ancestor_isolation_after_final_check; declaration_before_ordinary_admission_refuses_default_effect; pending_coverage_blocks_new_descendant; declaration_with_unfenced_ordinary_inflight_refuses; epic_reservation_consumes_common_publication_once; epic_common_lock_order_has_no_merge_store_cycle; pending_commit_failure_sends_no_effect; output_mid_batch_failure_retains_pending; isolation_clear_and_clone_replay_require_committed_evidence; narrow_squash_equal_tree_equal_base_positive; squash_changed_first_parent_or_result_tree_keeps_done; coverage_predecessor_cycle_or_missing_link_refuses. ADR/matrix specify paired outcomes, final-check barriers and exact receipt/fault assertions. Eventual fixtures use isolated HOME/repos/fake vendors/forges/credentials. No builds, tests, live launch/kernel/approval experiments; unprovided API is a prerequisite, not an executed test failure.

## Integrity evidence and remaining limits

All 26 pinned source hashes verified against git-show of committed main. **Concurrent working-tree edits appeared during final verification in lib.rs and status_cleanup.rs; they are not this author's work and were left untouched.** Initial full-checkout-equality assertion caught that change, so no clean-working-tree claim is made. verification.json records pinned source hashes, observed working hashes/status and supporting signoff/sketch hashes. V3 uses committed main, not those concurrent edits; future implementation must recheck actual integrated main. This pass authored only handoff/evidence artifacts and requested mailbox notification.

No canonical mutation, source edit, status/queue/grant/hold/activation/spawn, ADR docs publication, code commit, PR, merge or push. External TASK-1593/TASK-1591/BUG-1811/BUG-1812 and unrelated untracked work untouched. No absent-Joe question, authority fork answer or forced release. Checked persistence/common hooks/receipts remain engineering prerequisites, not implied availability. NEW different advisor must judge exact v3; no dispatch or self-signoff.

Advisor mailbox uses this report as body; notification ID/report hash is recorded separately in answered-sketch-v3-evidence/mailbox-notification.json after send.
